result.reviewScopeSummary: Verified Story 6 AC-5.1 through AC-5.5 against the story, tech design, test plan, boundary production code, amended tests, fixtures, goldens, red manifest, focused tests, story gate, epic gate, and one production-path probe for a legal trailing-turnless zone shape.

newFindings.title: Newest closed turn can be evicted when a later turnless singleton is in the visibility zone
newFindings.evidence: AC-5.3 requires that the newest closed turn is never evicted, and the story technical notes state `newest closed turn | never candidate for eviction` while `turn_id IS NULL` rows are singleton groups. In `boundary.ts`, `advanceDecision` builds `candidates` by only filtering the open turn, then excludes `candidates.length - 1` as the newest candidate group. When a turnless singleton appears after the newest closed turn, that singleton becomes the excluded newest candidate, leaving the newest closed turn eligible for eviction. A production-path probe through `createSdk` and real `intakeStream.messageEvents` with budgets 100/60 and groups t1=30 closed, t2=70 closed, trailing turnless=60 failed with `newest closed turn was evicted: expected boundary 3, observed 7`; observed boundary 7 is t2's tool result, so the newest closed turn flipped. Existing tests cover a turnless singleton before the final closed turn and a newest-closed case without a trailing turnless singleton, leaving this legal shape uncovered.

verified: AC-5.1: pipeline registers the existing post-commit advance callback but returns unless the committed batch recorded a turn_end; focused tests cover mid-turn no movement and byte-identical pulls.
AC-5.2: zone rows carry turn_id, groupZone groups turned rows together and null rows as singleton groups; tests assert whole-turn all-or-nothing for covered shapes.
AC-5.4: VisibilityBudgets is maxTokens/targetTokens, defaults resolve to 64000/32000, maxTokens <= targetTokens throws TypeError, and floorTokens is rejected as an unknown budget field.
AC-5.5: amended tests cover forward-only behavior, summary-else-truncation, compact reset, deterministic replay, post-commit failure visibility, and next-close healing.
TC-5.1: view-boundary-turn-end.test.ts covers mid-turn hold, close-triggered advance count, whole-turn flipping, small close no movement, and turnless singleton eviction.
TC-5.3: amended view-boundary.test.ts plus boundary trajectory golden cover Epic 03 regression legs under the new trigger.
unverified: AC-5.3: newest closed turn protection fails for a legal zone where a turnless singleton follows the newest closed turn.
TC-5.2: newest-closed-turn coverage is incomplete because the tests do not cover a trailing turnless singleton after the newest closed turn.

productionPathFindings: Production boundary decision can evict the newest closed turn when a later turnless singleton is present in the zone; this violates AC-5.3 on the real intake-to-boundary path.
additionalObservations: Production-path audit found no hidden floorTokens fallback or fake boundary advance surface in the reviewed runtime files.
The configured story gate and epic gate both pass, so the blocker is a behavioral coverage gap exposed by the additional AC-5.3 probe rather than a build, lint, typecheck, or existing-suite failure.
